get.description:
Collection read (A_OutbDeliveryHeader) with the filters the field worker uses (FR3.017):
``ShippingPoint eq '<plant>'`` (the SAMPLE plant ships from itself) and
``OverallPickingStatus ne 'C'`` / ``OverallGoodsMovementStatus ne 'C'``.

get.description:
Find documents by header text ``FIELD:<idempotency key>`` (timeout recovery, FR1.011).

Only this filter is supported. The sim keeps the key in its dedupe store rather than a header
text column; the response shape matches the S/4 collection read.

post.description:
Deep insert of a material document (e.g. 561 initial entry, GoodsMovementCode 05; 321 transfer).

With an Idempotency-Key the same request returns the first document (header text FIELD:<key> finds it).

get.description:
OData v2 endpoint to list functional locations with prefix and change date filtering.

Serves the JSON fixtures plus every location in erpsim.functional_location (the database wins
for the same FunctionalLocation), so towers created for a test read back as a tree.
